title: potentilla thurberi var. atrorubens
intro: Potentilla thurberi var. atrorubens, commonly known as Red Cinquefoil, is a flowering plant species belonging to the rose family (Rosaceae) and native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla thurberi var. atrorubens include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and antiseptic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, suggesting its potential use in traditional medicine and as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
